url.title: URL
url.description: Media file URL (the episode's enclosure for podcasts), storeId/key for a key-value store record, or the feed URL when a feed failed.

sourceType.title: Source type
sourceType.description: url, kv (key-value store record) or rss (podcast feed episode).

feedUrl.title: Feed URL
feedUrl.description: Podcast RSS feed the episode came from.

title.title: Title
title.description: Episode title, or the file name.

episodeGuid.title: Episode GUID
episodeGuid.description: The episode's guid in the feed.

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: From the Content-Disposition header, the URL path or the record key.

model.title: Model
model.description: Whisper model used: base or small.

language.title: Language
language.description: Detected (or given) language code, e.g. en, de, es.

languageProbability.title: Language confidence
languageProbability.description: Confidence of the language detection (0-1); 1 when the language was given.

durationSeconds.title: Duration (s)
durationSeconds.description: Length of the audio in seconds.

billedMinutes.title: Billed minutes
billedMinutes.description: Started minutes of audio billed for this file (on the first chunk only in chunks format; 0 on failure).

text.title: Text
text.description: The full transcript, or one chunk's text. Null on failure.
text.example: We choose to go to the moon and disdicate and do the other things, not because they are easy, but because they are hot. Three, two, one, zero, all engine running. Lift off, we have a lift off, 32 minutes past the hour, lift off on Apollo 11.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Timestamped segments [{start, end, text}] in seconds (transcript format).

example.text: We choose to go to the moon and disdicate and do the other things, not because they are easy, but because they are hot.

chunkIndex.title: Chunk index
chunkIndex.description: 0-based chunk number within the file (chunks format).

chunkCount.title: Chunks
chunkCount.description: Number of chunks for the file (chunks format).

startTime.title: Start (s)
startTime.description: Chunk start, in seconds from the start of the media (chunks format).

endTime.title: End (s)
endTime.description: Chunk end, in seconds from the start of the media (chunks format).

srtUrl.title: SRT subtitles
srtUrl.description: Link to the SRT subtitle file in the run's key-value store.

vttUrl.title: VTT subtitles
vttUrl.description: Link to the WebVTT subtitle file in the run's key-value store.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Notes such as a damaged file whose end could not be decoded.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the file failed (not billed), or null on success.

transcribedAt.title: Transcribed at
transcribedAt.description: When the file was transcribed (ISO 8601 UTC).
